blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Adversarial attacks on vision-language models optimize an image toward a text target, then cite the attacked model's similarity score as evidence of success. We ask whether that score - victim-space target alignment (VTS) - predicts recovery of the target by an independent model. We first build a measurement instrument: supervised judges outside the attacked geometry, real-target blend controls, shuffled-target negatives, and a reference level derived from a 50% target-image blend. Two preregistered studies then compare six contrastive encoders under a matched attack at three perturbation budgets. Robustly trained encoders (FARE, TeCoA, PMG, TRADES) transfer substantially more independent evidence than vanilla CLIP or SigLIP; all eight contrasts reject at the bootstrap floor. However, no cell reaches the blend-derived reference level. The three best cells fall within its replication band, leaving practical recovery undecided. Within robust encoders, per-sample alignment gain correlates with evidence gain ($ρ= 0.24-0.51$); within vanilla CLIP the correlation is consistent with zero. Across encoders we find no monotone alignment-evidence relation. VTS is therefore informative only within a fixed robust encoder, and we provide a reporting protocol in its place.
blocks.zh: 对视觉语言模型的负面攻击优化了图像对文本目标,然后引用被攻击模型的相似性分数作为成功的证据. 我们询问,这一分数 -- -- 受害者与空间目标一致 -- -- 是否通过独立模式预测目标恢复。 我们首先建造一个测量仪器: 被攻击几何之外受监督的判官, 真实目标混合控制, 冲洗目标负数, 以及从50%的目标图像混合中得出的参考水平。 两项预先登记的研究随后比较了6个对比编码器在3个扰动预算的匹配攻击下. 训练有素的编码器(FARE、TeCoA、PMG、TradeS)比香草CLIP或SigLIP转移大量独立证据;所有8种对比都拒绝在靴子层。 然而,没有单元格达到混合产生的参考水平。 三个最好的细胞都属于它的复制带,使得实际恢复没有被确定. 在坚固的编码器中,每个样本的校正与证据增益相关(0.24-0.51美元);在香草CLIP中,相关性与零一致。 通过编码器 我们发现没有单酮对齐 -证据关系。 因此,只在一个固定的坚固编码器内提供情况,我们提供了一个报告程序。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Optimizing an image to increase its similarity to a text target in a contrastive model’s embedding space is a standard step in adversarial attacks on vision–language systems [ 41 , 16 , 11 ] . After optimization, the attacker reports the resulting score as evidence that the attack succeeded in inducing the target concept. The practice is widespread because the quantity is cheap to compute, directly optimized, and available to any white-box attack. But it is computed by the same encoder being optimized, so it rises under attack regardless of whether any other model can recognize the intended target. This circularity is not a hypothetical concern: prior work has shown that adversarial images can score high on victim-side alignment while failing entirely under independent evaluation. Zhang and others [42] found that adversarial images yield 0% target recovery under an independent classifier while images generated from their embeddings yield 64%, separating input-level alignment from generative recovery.
blocks.zh: 在对比模型的嵌入空间中优化一个图像以增加它与文本目标的相似性,是对视觉-语言系统的对抗攻击的标准步骤[41,16,11]. 优化后,攻击者将由此得到的分数报告为攻击成功诱导目标概念的证据. 这种做法很普遍,因为数量很便宜,可以计算,直接优化,可供任何白盒攻击使用. 但是它是通过同样的编码器被优化来计算,所以它上升受到攻击,不管是否有任何其他模型能够识别预定目标. 这种循环不是一种假设性的关切:先前的工作表明,对抗性图像在受害者-一方的配合上会得分很高,而完全无法接受独立评估。 张等[42]发现相对抗的图像在独立分级器下产生0%的目标恢复,而由嵌入所生成的图像则产生64%,将输入级对接与基因恢复区分开来.

blocks.en: Despite this known gap, victim-side alignment remains the default evidence in adversarial semantic claims on contrastive models. Attacks are compared by their alignment scores, defenses are evaluated by how much they reduce alignment, and “semantic” conclusions are drawn from a quantity that the attacker controls. What remains unresolved is a narrower and more actionable question: when does increased alignment in the attacked model predict independently measured recovery?
blocks.zh: 尽管存在已知的这一差距,但受害者-侧向调整仍然是对抗性语义性索赔中关于对比性模型的默认证据。 袭击按其配对分数加以比较,防御按其减少配对的程度加以评价,并从攻击者控制的数量中得出“语义”结论。 仍未解决的是一个范围更窄、更可操作的问题:受攻击的模型的更趋一致何时能预测独立计量的恢复?

blocks.en: We approach this as a measurement problem rather than an attack-design problem. Our instrument pairs supervised judges, architecturally outside the contrastive family, with graded real-target blend controls and shuffled-target negatives, anchored to a reference level set by the mean independent evidence of a 50% target-image blend. Two preregistered studies evaluate vanilla CLIP [ 26 ] , four adversarially fine-tuned variants (FARE, TeCoA, PMG, TRADES), and SigLIP [ 38 ] (a second contrastive family with a sigmoid objective), under a matched fixed-target attack at ϵ ∈ { 4 , 16 , 64 } / 255 \epsilon\in\{4,16,64\}/255 , on held-out images with regenerated target mappings. A preregistered recipe comparison additionally tests whether stronger standard attacks (targeted PGD, C&W) change any conclusion.
blocks.zh: 我们将此视为一个测量问题,而不是攻击设计问题。 我们的仪器配对监督法官, 建筑上在对比性家庭之外, 有分级的真-目标混合控制 和洗-目标负数, 固定在一个参考水平 由50%的目标-图像混合的平均独立证据。 两个预先注册的研究评价了香草 CLIP [26],四个对抗性微调的变体(FAE, TeCoA, PMG, TradeS),和SigLIP [38](一个有相片目标的第二个对比性家族),在XQQQ {4,16,64 }/ 255\epsilon\in 4,16,64/X/255的对应固定目标攻击下,被搁置了带有再生成目标映射的图像. 预先注册的食谱比较还进一步检验更强的标准攻击(目标PGD,C&W)是否改变任何结论.

blocks.en: Three results emerge. First, robustly fine-tuned encoders transfer more independent target evidence than non-adversarially trained ones. All eight robust-versus-naive contrasts reject at the bootstrap floor. SigLIP, which differs from vanilla CLIP in objective, scale, and training recipe, stays at vanilla-like levels. Second, no cell’s mean evidence reaches the blend reference level. The three nearest cells fall within the replication band of that level, so the question of practical recovery remains open rather than settled. Third, alignment gain predicts evidence gain within robust encoders ( ρ = 0.24 \rho=0.24 – 0.51 0.51 ) but not within vanilla CLIP (consistent with zero under a post-hoc approximation), and we find no monotone alignment–evidence relation across encoders. The naive-versus-robust inversion is real but does not extend to SigLIP.
blocks.zh: 现出三果. 首先,精细化的编码器传输比非对抗性训练的更独立的目标证据. 所有8个强与弱对比 都拒绝在靴子地上。 与香草CLIP在客观,规模,培训食谱上不同的SigLIP则停留在香草同级. 第二,没有单元格的平均值达到混合参考水平。 最近的3个细胞属于这一级的复制范围,因此实际恢复问题仍未解决而未解决。 第三,对接收益预测的是强编码器内部的证据对接收益(^ = 0.24\rho=0.24–0.51 0.51),但不在香草CLIP内部(在后热近似器下与0一致),我们发现没有单通对接–跨编码器的证据关系. 天真对生性倒置是真实的,但不延伸至SigLIP.

blocks.en: An evidence taxonomy (L0 target intent through L4 human grounding) frames what each type of claim requires; our results are scoped to machine-level evidence (L1 and L2). Our contributions are:
blocks.zh: 证据分类法(L0目标意图,通过L4人类地平线)规定了每一类索赔的要求;我们的结果范围为机器一级的证据(L1和L2)。 我们的贡献是:

blocks.en: 1. A calibrated measurement instrument for independent target recovery, combining supervised judges outside the contrastive family, graded real-target blend positive controls, shuffled-target negatives, and a pre-specified reference level derived from a 50% target-image blend. All controls are preregistered and their outputs are independently validated. 2. A cross-encoder boundary map : the first systematic evidence that adversarially fine-tuned encoders transfer more independent target evidence than non-adversarially trained ones, quantified across four robust recipes and two contrastive families (six encoders total) at three perturbation budgets under preregistered contrasts. 3. A two-level diagnosticity finding : victim-space alignment is informative within robust encoders ( ρ = 0.24 \rho=0.24 – 0.51 0.51 ), consistent with zero within vanilla CLIP, and we find no monotone relation across encoders. This separates the metric’s within-encoder use from its (unsupported) cross-encoder use. 4. A reporting protocol for adversarial semantic claims, specifying the evidence required at each level and the calibration steps that prior transfer-evaluation approaches lack.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Universal adversarial triggers originate in text classification [ 36 ] ; discrete gradient-based suffix search was systematized for LLM jailbreaks by GCG [ 43 ] . Recent attacks on CLIP-scale models include targeted generators [ 41 ] and universal perturbations [ 11 , 16 ] . Several evaluate on models beyond the surrogate (AnyAttack transfers to unseen target VLMs; Springer et al. [32] study robust-source targeted transfer), but their endpoint is attack or transfer success, not target-specific evidence calibrated against positive and negative controls.
blocks.zh: 通用对抗触发器起源于文本分类 [36];基于梯度的离散后缀搜索被GCG系统化了LLM越狱[43]. 最近对CLIP规模模型的攻击包括目标发电机[41]和普遍扰动[11,16]. 若干评价了替代物以外的模型(AnyAttack向看不见的目标VLMs的转移;Springer等[32]研究强源目标转移),但其端点是攻击或转移成功,而不是针对目标的特定证据对正负控制进行校正.

blocks.en: Bhattad et al. [5] craft unrestricted semantic-manipulation attacks that preserve source-class content. Elsayed et al. [10] show that adversarial perturbations bias time-limited human choices, reporting 57–89% targeted transfer to models outside the optimization. Veerabadran et al. [35] demonstrate that bounded perturbations bias human category judgments toward the chosen class. Zhang et al. [39] generate attacks whose original concept remains identifiable. These works establish that human evaluation of adversarial content has precedent; our contribution is the calibration protocol (graded controls, shuffle correction, a frozen reference level) applied across contrastive encoders and budgets, which none of them provide.
blocks.zh: Bhattad等 (英语). [5] 工艺无限制语义-操纵攻击,保存出源类内容. Elsayed et al. 互联网档案馆的存檔,存档日期2013-12-21. [10] 显示对抗性扰动偏向于有时间限制的人类选择,报告57-89%的定向转移到优化外的模型. Veerabadran等人[35]证明,受约束的扰动使人类类别判断偏向于被选择的阶层。 张等. [39] 产生其原始概念仍可识别的攻击. 这些工作确定,人类对对抗性内容的评价是有先例的;我们的贡献是适用于对比性编码器和预算的校正协议(分级控制,洗涤校正,被冻结的参考水平),它们都没有提供.

blocks.en: Adversarial examples exploit predictive but non-robust features [ 18 ] ; robust classifiers carry perceptually aligned gradients [ 28 , 19 ] , which can be promoted without adversarial training while remaining associated with robustness [ 15 ] . Off-manifold robustness helps explain this property [ 33 ] . Gradient alignment in CLIP-family encoders has been characterized [ 14 ] ; on-manifold perturbations relate robustness to generalization [ 34 , 21 ] ; the joint space has a modality gap [ 22 , 20 ] . None of this work conditions independent recoverability on victim robustness; the nearest results show that adversarially trained sources produce more transferable attacks [ 2 ] and that robustified CLIP induces better perceptual metrics [ 8 ] ; neither endpoint is calibrated target evidence.

blocks.en: Obfuscated gradients taught the field that evaluation under optimization requires adversarial scrutiny [ 1 ] ; attack implementations and judge protocols remain sources of distortion [ 7 , 23 , 17 , 31 , 6 , 30 ] , and human-grounded frameworks audit automated judges against perception [ 12 ] . Psychometric validity theory is being imported into ML evaluation [ 3 , 27 , 13 ] , covering both language and vision. No prior work addresses adversarial semantic claims with the calibrated protocol used here. We extend the evaluation-validity line from “is the attack real?” to “does the semantic metric mean what it is used to mean?” Universal-suffix work in the LLM domain independently supports non-semantic readings of trigger success [ 4 ] .

blocks.en: 3 An Evidence Taxonomy for Adversarial Claims
blocks.zh: 3 横向索赔的证据分类

blocks.en: Adversarial “semantic” claims conflate several distinct questions. We separate them into levels: L0 target intent (WordNet or other ontology), L1 victim-space alignment (VTS), L2 independent-model recovery (ITE), L3 downstream propagation, and L4 human grounding. Passing one level does not imply passing another. Our results address L1 and L2; we do not claim L3 or L4 evidence.
blocks.zh: 矛盾的“语义”索赔将几个不同的问题混为一谈。 我们将其分为:L0目标意图(WordNet或其他肿瘤学)、L1受害者-空间对接(VTS)、L2独立模式恢复(ITE)、L3下游传播和L4人地面。 通过一个级别并不意味着通过另一个级别。 我们的结果涉及L1和L2;我们不要求L3或L4证据。

blocks.en: Terminology. VTS (victim-space target similarity) is cosine to the frozen target text embedding in the victim. ITE (independent target evidence) is the shuffle-corrected change in the target’s logit margin on an independent judge. ITR (rank recovery, anchor in top-5) is corroborating secondary. Calling an L1 quantity “semantic injection” or “semantic coherence” without L2 or higher evidence is a category error under this framework; we apply the same rule to our own claims.
blocks.zh: 术语。 VTS(受害者-空间目标相似性)与嵌入在受害者体内的被冻结的目标文本是同位素. ITE(独立目标证据)是独立法官对目标登录比值进行洗刷修正后的变化. ITR(排名恢复,锚地在前5位)是证实二级. 将L1数量的“语义注射”或“语义一致性”称为“无L2或更高证据”是本框架下的一个类别错误;我们对自己的索赔适用同样的规则。

blocks.en: This taxonomy draws on validity-evidence thinking from measurement theory [ 9 , 25 ] , adapted for adversarial evaluation. Concurrent work imports the same theory for ML evaluation more broadly [ 3 , 27 , 13 ] , covering both language and vision; ours applies it specifically to adversarial semantic claims on vision–language models, with the calibrated protocol (blend positive controls, shuffled negatives, a frozen reference level) that prior frameworks do not provide. The mapping to Messick’s validity aspects (L1 as structural, L2 as external/convergent, L3 as consequential, L4 as substantive-plus-content) is heuristic rather than established; it serves as a bridge, not a derivation.
blocks.zh: 这种分类法借鉴了从计量理论[9,25]中得出的有效性-证据思维,为对抗性评价所改编. 同时期工作为ML评价更广泛地导入了同一种理论[3,27,13],涵盖了语言和视觉两个方面;我们的理论专门将其应用于视觉语言模型上的对立语义主张,有校正的协议(blend正控,shuffled负,被冻结的参考水平),而先前的框架并没有提供. 绘制梅西克有效性方面的地图(L1作为结构问题,L2作为外部/召集问题,L3作为后果问题,L4作为实质性加内容问题)是充满活力的,而不是既定的;它是一座桥梁,而不是衍生物。

blocks.en: 4 Methods
blocks.zh: 4 方法

blocks.en: 4.1 Study A: instrument validation
blocks.zh: 4.1 研究A:仪器验证

blocks.en: Judges. The primary judge is ResNet-50 (ImageNet-1k, supervised), chosen for architectural and training disjointness from the ViT-B/32 victims. The secondary judge, ViT-B/16 (supervised), is reported in the artifacts; it shares the ViT family with the victims, so it corroborates direction and ordering but not scale. Both judges operate on the same 1000-class ImageNet label space, which is the space our evaluation classes map into.
blocks.zh: 诸法官. 主要法官是ResNet-50(ImageNet-1k,监督),被选为与Vit-B/32受害者断绝联系的建筑和培训法官。 二级法官Vit-B/16(受监督)在文物中被报道;它与受害者分享Vit家族,因此它证实了方向和命令,但没有规模. 两位评委在同一个1000级的ImageNet标签空间上运作,这是我们评价类地图进入的空间.

blocks.en: Controls. PC1 (judge competence): clean target-class exemplars establish per-class coverage. PC2 (graded positive control): source images blended with a real target-class image at doses α ∈ { 0.25 , 0.5 , 0.75 , 1.0 } \alpha\in\{0.25,0.5,0.75,1.0\} ; the blend constructor is never used as a judge. blocks.en: The preregistered recipe could in principle sit far below the achievable optimization frontier, reducing the boundary claim to a statement about one optimizer. We ran targeted PGD and C&W-style attacks (100 iterations each) alongside the preregistered recipe on exploration-only data, under the identical cohort, anchors, shuffles, and judge. No variant crosses S min S_{\min} in any cell; the preregistered recipe itself achieves the highest ITE in five of six victim-budget combinations. PGD-100 attains higher victim-side alignment (VTS up to 0.63 vs. 0.49) while transferring equal or less evidence. This is a within-optimization replication of the L1 ⟂ \perp L2 dissociation: pushing the victim’s target score harder does not buy more external evidence (Table 8 ).

blocks.en: 6 Discussion
blocks.zh: 讨论

blocks.en: Within a robustly fine-tuned encoder, VTS tracks independent evidence per sample. Within vanilla CLIP, the monotone association is consistent with zero under a post-hoc approximation. Across encoders, the naive-versus-robust inversion does not extend to SigLIP. These three facts together limit VTS to a within-encoder diagnostic for robust checkpoints. To quantify the cross-encoder prediction question, we ran a post-hoc sensitivity check (not preregistered; class-grouped 5-fold cross-validation over 8,100 pooled records): adding Δ \Delta VTS to an additive encoder-plus-budget baseline changes top-5-recovery AUC from 0.829 to 0.839 and R 2 R^{2} from 0.236 to 0.288. These are small positive increments under this specific baseline, split, and set of endpoints. The folds hold out source classes, not encoders, so the result applies to seen encoders and does not establish or rule out incremental value in other settings.
blocks.zh: 在一个精细的编码器内,VTS跟踪每个样本的独立证据. 在香草CLIP内部,单酮结合在后热相近下与0一致. 在整个编码器中,天真对活塞倒置并没有延伸到SigLIP. 这三个事实加在一起,将VTS限制为对强有力的检查站进行内部编码诊断。 为了量化交叉编码器预测问题,我们进行了一次热度后敏感度检查(没有预先登记;在8,100个集合记录上进行了5倍的分级交叉验证):在添加编码器+预算基准中添加了\\Delta VTS,最高5回收的AUC从0.829到0.839,R 2 RQQX2}从0.236到0.288。 这些是这一具体基线下小的正递增、分出和一组终点。 折叠会持有出源类,而不是编码器,所以结果适用于所见到的编码器,在其他设置中不会建立或排除增量值.

blocks.en: Two findings sit side by side. Robust recipes show higher mean ITE than naive ones: large effects, monotone in budget, Holm-corrected. Within robust cells, alignment gain correlates with evidence gain; the correlation itself is not monotone in budget (FARE peaks at ϵ = 16 \epsilon{=}16 ). Neither finding is a training-causal claim, because the encoders are released checkpoints rather than matched interventions. No cell’s mean reaches the reference level, even at ϵ = 64 / 255 \epsilon{=}64/255 , an unusually large budget. The evaluation budgets exceed the reported TeCoA training budget; FARE’s exact training budget is unresolved. The contrasts are budget-matched, so the robust-naive gap is not explained by budget differences, but recipe attribution and interpretation relative to training budgets require verified provenance.
blocks.zh: 两个发现并存。 强食谱显示的ITE平均值高于天真:大效果,预算单调,Holm修正. 在坚固的单元格中,校正与证据增益相关;其相关性本身并不是预算中的单调(FARE峰值为 QQ = 16\epsilon QX 16)。 两者都不是培训原因,因为编码员被放出检查站,而不是配合干预。 没有单元格的平均值达到参考水平,即使是在XQ = 64 / 255\epsilon 64/255, 预算异常庞大。 评价预算超过所报告的TeCoA培训预算;FARE的确切培训预算尚未解决。 两者的对比是相匹配的,因此巨大差异不是预算差异造成的,但与培训预算相比,配方的归属和解释需要核实来源。

blocks.en: The three best cells sit between the two anchor calibrations ( 5.371 5.371 frozen, 4.65 4.65 replicated). We report them as inconclusive rather than resolved in either direction. The anchor’s calibration uncertainty (approximately 15% between draws) is comparable to the gap between these cells and the reference level, which is exactly the situation where a binary verdict would be misleading.
blocks.zh: 三个最好的细胞坐落在两个锚地校正之间(5.371 5.371被冻结,4.65 4.65被复制). 我们报告说,它们是没有结果的,而不是在两个方向都得到解决。 锚点的校正不确定性(在平分之间约为15%)与这些单元格和参考水平之间的差距相当,这正是二进制判断会产生误导的情况。

blocks.en: No existing standard covers what an adversarial “semantic” claim needs to report. In place of raw VTS, we recommend: (i) scope alignment claims to the evaluated encoder; (ii) report at least one validated independent endpoint, with graded real-target positive controls, shuffled-target negatives, and a judge competence check; (iii) state the optimization recipe and its distance to standard stronger attacks; (iv) for robust encoders, evaluate at and just beyond the training budget. These four items distinguish the calibration protocol from prior transfer-evaluation approaches.
blocks.zh: 没有任何现行标准涵盖对抗性“语义”索赔需要报告的内容。 代替原始VTS,我们建议: (一)对被评价编码器进行范围校正要求; (二)报告至少一个经验证的独立端点,分级为正目标控制,分级为正目标负数,并进行法官胜任能力检查; (三)说明优化配方及其与标准更强攻击的距离; (四)对稳码员,在培训预算左右评价. 这四个项目将校正协议与先前的转让评估方法区分开来.

blocks.en: The standard evaluation in this space reports attack success rate or victim-side alignment. Our instrument adds three things: graded real-target blend controls that establish the judge’s sensitivity to actual target evidence; shuffled-target negatives that correct for non-specific logit-mass movement; and a pre-specified reference level that anchors the verdict to a measurable quantity rather than a threshold chosen post hoc. Any of these can be adopted independently of the others.
blocks.zh: 本空间报告的标准评价攻击成功率或受害者与受害者之间的一致。 我们的仪器增加了三件事:确定法官对实际目标证据的敏感度的分级实际目标混合控制;纠正非特定对数质量运动的分级目标负数;以及预先确定的基准水平,将判决定在可计量的数量而不是选择的临界值。 任何这些措施都可以独立于其他措施。

blocks.en: The observed pattern is consistent with robust-features and off-manifold accounts [ 18 , 28 , 33 , 34 , 2 ] , but no mechanism quantity was measured confirmatorily. Identifying the causal pathway from adversarial training to independent evidence transfer would require matched training interventions or a continuous robustness axis, which are outside the scope of this paper.
blocks.zh: 所观察到的模式符合稳健的地貌和离谱的叙述[18、28、33、34、2],但没有对机制数量进行确认。 确定从对抗性培训到独立证据转移的因果途径需要相应的培训干预或持续坚固轴心,这些都不属于本文件的范围。

blocks.en: Six encoders (five ViT-B/32-family recipes plus SigLIP), one dataset (ImageNet-100), one attack objective (fixed-target), three budgets, one preregistered recipe. The preregistered cross-encoder anti-ordering hypothesis failed ( ρ ≈ 0 \rho\approx 0 ); the between-encoder claim is therefore stated conditionally. Fine-grained and texture datasets were not run (classes outside the judge’s label space). Encoders are released checkpoints, not matched training interventions; FARE’s training budget is unresolved. Claims are capped at L2 under supervised ImageNet-1k judges (no L3 or L4 endpoint; the secondary judge shares the ViT family). The reference level inherits approximately 15% inter-draw uncertainty. No mechanism quantity was measured confirmatorily. The adaptive-objective arm was dropped by its own preregistered gate.

blocks.en: Several extensions follow from these findings. Matched training interventions that vary adversarial-training strength along a continuum would isolate whether robustness itself causes the alignment–evidence gap or whether the gap tracks a correlated property of the released checkpoints. Extending the instrument to additional judge paradigms (self-supervised probes, zero-shot captioning models) would test whether the L2 boundary is judge-specific or a property of the encoders themselves. Downstream propagation (L3) remains untested: if the classifier-level evidence we measure propagates to generative or retrieval endpoints, the sub-threshold finding may understate the practical risk. The reporting protocol could be developed into a community benchmark covering additional attack families, encoder architectures, and perturbation norms. A human-grounded study (L4) would determine whether the blend-derived reference level corresponds to any perceptual threshold.
blocks.zh: 从这些调查结果中可以看出若干延伸。 相互匹配的训练干预措施在连续的对抗性训练强度上各不相同,这将孤立强健性本身是否造成校正-证据差距,或差距是否跟踪已放行检查站的相关财产。 将仪器扩展至额外的判断范式(自控探测器,零发字幕模型)将测试L2边界是判断器特有还是编码器本身的财产. 下游传播(L3)仍未经过测试:如果我们测量的分级证据传播到基因或检索终点,次阈值发现可能会低估实际风险。 报告协议可以发展成为涵盖更多攻击家庭、编码器结构和扰动规范的社区基准。 一项基于人类的研究(L4)将确定混合产生的参考水平是否与任何感知阈值相符。
